title: Aircraft Rescue Firefighting in Kandahar
description: Afghan airfield firefighters are taking responsibility for their own training, with guidance from US Army firefighters of the 683rd Engineer Detachment and US Air Force mentors of NATO Air Training Command's 438th Air Expeditionary Wing. Sound bites from Pfc. Christopher Minix, Firefighting Trainer, 683rd Engineer Detachment and 1LT Mohammed Noor, Fire Chief, 77th Kandahar Air Wing F.D. Available in high definition.
